title: Safety of Household and Similar Electrical Appliances
summary: Covers general safety requirements for household electrical appliances such as mixers, irons, and heaters, including protection against electric shock, mechanical hazards, and fire.
scope: Electrical appliances for household and similar use, rated voltage not exceeding 250V single-phase.

title: Hot Rolled Medium and High Tensile Structural Steel
summary: Specifies requirements for hot rolled steel products used in general structural purposes such as bridges and buildings, including chemical composition and mechanical properties.
scope: Plates, strips, angles, and structural steel sections used in construction and fabrication.

title: Protective Helmets for Two-Wheeler Riders
summary: Specifies requirements for protective helmets including shock absorption, penetration resistance, retention system strength, and field of vision.
scope: Helmets for riders and pillion riders of two-wheeled motor vehicles.

title: Methods of Physical Tests for Hydraulic Cement
summary: Describes methods for testing physical properties of cement including fineness, setting time, soundness, and compressive strength.
scope: All types of hydraulic cement including ordinary Portland cement and blended cements.

title: Mild Steel Tubes, Tubulars and Other Wrought Steel Fittings
summary: Covers requirements for steel tubes used for water, gas, and steam applications, specifying dimensions, tolerances, and mechanical properties.
scope: Welded and seamless steel tubes used in plumbing and structural applications.

title: Portable Fire Extinguishers - Specification
summary: Specifies requirements for portable fire extinguishers including construction, capacity, and performance testing for effective fire suppression.
scope: Portable fire extinguishers used in residential, commercial, and industrial settings.

title: Plastics - Methods of Testing
summary: Provides testing methodology for plastic materials including tensile strength, density, and thermal properties.
scope: Raw plastic materials and finished plastic products across industries.

title: PVC Insulated Cables for Electric Power and Lighting
summary: Specifies requirements for PVC insulated electric cables used for power and lighting wiring, including insulation thickness and voltage grade.
scope: Single-core and multi-core PVC insulated cables up to 1100V grade.

title: High Strength Deformed Steel Bars for Concrete Reinforcement
summary: Specifies requirements for TMT (Thermo-Mechanically Treated) steel bars used for reinforcing concrete structures, including tensile strength and bend test requirements.
scope: Reinforcement bars used in RCC construction of buildings, bridges, and other structures.

title: Pressure Cookers - Specification
summary: Specifies safety and performance requirements for household pressure cookers including lid locking mechanism, safety valve, and pressure release systems.
scope: Domestic aluminium and stainless steel pressure cookers.

title: Mechanical Testing of Metals - Tensile Testing
summary: Describes the method for tensile testing of metallic materials at room temperature to determine yield strength, tensile strength, and elongation.
scope: Metallic materials in the form of sheets, bars, wires, and tubes.

title: Toy Safety - General Requirements
summary: Specifies safety requirements for toys including mechanical and physical properties, flammability, and migration of certain hazardous elements.
scope: Toys intended for use by children up to 14 years of age.

title: Plain and Reinforced Concrete - Code of Practice
summary: General code of practice for design, detailing, construction and testing of plain and reinforced concrete structures, widely referenced in civil engineering.
scope: Design and construction of concrete structures in buildings and infrastructure.

title: Coarse and Fine Aggregate for Concrete - Specification
summary: Specifies requirements for natural and manufactured aggregates used in concrete, covering grading, quality, and deleterious material limits.
scope: Aggregates used in plain and reinforced cement concrete.

title: Ordinary Portland Cement - Specification (33 Grade)
summary: Specifies physical and chemical requirements for 33-grade ordinary Portland cement used in general construction.
scope: OPC 33-grade cement manufactured and sold in India.

title: Ordinary Portland Cement - Specification (43 Grade)
summary: Specifies physical and chemical requirements for 43-grade ordinary Portland cement, commonly used in RCC work.
scope: OPC 43-grade cement manufactured and sold in India.

title: Ordinary Portland Cement - Specification (53 Grade)
summary: Specifies physical and chemical requirements for 53-grade ordinary Portland cement, used where higher early strength is required.
scope: OPC 53-grade cement manufactured and sold in India.

title: Common Burnt Clay Building Bricks - Specification
summary: Specifies classification, dimensions, and quality requirements for common burnt clay bricks used in masonry construction.
scope: Burnt clay bricks used in general building construction.

title: General Construction in Steel - Code of Practice
summary: Provides design principles and practice for general construction using structural steel, covering loads, member design, and connections.
scope: Design of steel structures including buildings and industrial structures.

title: Cold Reduced Low Carbon Steel Sheet and Strip - Specification
summary: Specifies requirements for cold rolled low carbon steel sheets and strips used in automotive, appliance, and general engineering applications.
scope: Cold reduced steel sheet and strip in coil or cut length form.

title: Galvanized Steel Sheets (Plain and Corrugated) - Specification
summary: Specifies requirements for hot-dip zinc-coated (galvanized) steel sheets used for roofing and general sheet metal work.
scope: Plain and corrugated galvanized steel sheets.

title: Code of Practice for Earthing
summary: Provides guidelines for the earthing of electrical installations to ensure safety against electric shock and equipment damage.
scope: Earthing systems for buildings, industrial plants, and electrical installations.

title: Code of Practice for Electrical Wiring Installations
summary: Covers general principles for design, installation, and testing of electrical wiring systems in buildings up to 650V.
scope: Domestic and low-voltage electrical wiring installations.

title: Low-Voltage Switchgear and Controlgear
summary: Specifies requirements for low-voltage switchgear and controlgear assemblies, including circuit breakers and switches.
scope: Switchgear and controlgear rated up to 1000V AC.

title: Self-Ballasted LED Lamps for General Lighting - Safety Specification
summary: Specifies safety requirements for self-ballasted LED lamps used for general household and similar lighting purposes.
scope: LED lamps intended for general lighting service.

title: Electric Ceiling Type Fans and Regulators - Specification
summary: Specifies performance, safety, and construction requirements for electric ceiling fans and their speed regulators.
scope: Domestic and commercial electric ceiling fans.

title: Room Air Conditioners - Specification
summary: Specifies safety, performance, and energy efficiency requirements for room/split air conditioners.
scope: Domestic and light commercial room air conditioners.

title: Household Refrigerators - Specification
summary: Specifies safety and performance requirements for household refrigerators, including insulation, cooling performance, and electrical safety.
scope: Domestic single and multi-door refrigerators.

title: Electric Irons - Specification
summary: Specifies safety and performance requirements for household electric dry and steam irons.
scope: Domestic electric flat irons.

title: Liquefied Petroleum Gas (LPG) Cylinders - Specification
summary: Specifies design, material, and testing requirements for refillable LPG gas cylinders used for domestic and commercial cooking fuel.
scope: Welded steel LPG cylinders for household and commercial use.

title: LPG Pressure Regulators for Domestic Use - Specification
summary: Specifies safety and performance requirements for pressure regulators used with domestic LPG cylinders.
scope: Single-stage LPG pressure regulators for household cooking use.

title: LPG Gas Stoves (Domestic) - Specification
summary: Specifies safety and performance requirements for domestic gas stoves used with LPG, including burner efficiency and leak safety.
scope: Domestic LPG cooking stoves with one or more burners.

title: Packaged Drinking Water (Other Than Mineral Water) - Specification
summary: Specifies quality, safety, and packaging requirements for packaged drinking water sold to consumers.
scope: Bottled/packaged drinking water for retail sale.

title: Packaged Natural Mineral Water - Specification
summary: Specifies quality and compositional requirements for natural mineral water intended for retail packaging and sale.
scope: Bottled natural mineral water for retail sale.

title: Infant Milk Food - Specification
summary: Specifies compositional and safety requirements for infant milk food products sold in India.
scope: Processed infant milk food for babies.

title: Edible Common Salt - Specification
summary: Specifies quality requirements for edible common salt, including iodization limits where applicable.
scope: Common salt intended for human consumption.

title: Household and Similar Electrical Appliances - Air Fryers and Similar Cooking Appliances Safety
summary: Covers general and particular safety requirements for small household electric cooking appliances, extending household appliance safety principles to newer product types.
scope: Small household electric cooking appliances.

title: Leather Safety Footwear - Specification
summary: Specifies design, material, and performance requirements for leather safety footwear used in industrial and occupational settings.
scope: Leather safety shoes and boots for industrial workers.

title: Industrial Rubber Boots - Specification
summary: Specifies requirements for rubber boots used in industrial and hazardous work environments, including chemical and puncture resistance.
scope: Rubber safety boots for industrial and agricultural use.

title: Rubber Gloves for Electrical Purposes - Specification
summary: Specifies requirements for insulating rubber gloves used by electrical workers to protect against electric shock.
scope: Rubber gloves used for live-line and electrical maintenance work.

title: Industrial Safety Helmets - Specification
summary: Specifies requirements for protective helmets used in industrial workplaces, covering impact resistance and penetration protection.
scope: Industrial hard hats used at construction and factory sites.

title: Safety Belts and Harnesses for Working at Heights - Specification
summary: Specifies design, material, and testing requirements for safety belts and full-body harnesses used during work at height.
scope: Fall-protection safety belts and harnesses for industrial use.

title: Protective Clothing - Protection Against Heat and Flame
summary: Specifies performance requirements for protective clothing designed to give limited flame spread protection.
scope: Industrial protective garments used near heat and flame hazards.

title: Two-Wheeler Bicycles - Safety Requirements
summary: Specifies safety and construction requirements for pedal bicycles, including braking, structural strength, and reflectors.
scope: Bicycles for general use, excluding electric cycles.

title: Mobile Phone Chargers - Safety Requirements
summary: Specifies safety requirements for AC power adapters used to charge mobile phones and similar portable electronic devices.
scope: Mobile phone and portable device chargers sold in India.

title: Information Technology Equipment - Safety Requirements
summary: Specifies general safety requirements for information technology equipment including laptops, desktops, and related peripherals.
scope: IT hardware including computers, monitors, and printers.

title: Audio, Video and Similar Electronic Apparatus - Safety Requirements
summary: Specifies safety requirements for audio, video, and similar electronic entertainment equipment such as speakers and smart devices.
scope: Consumer audio/video electronic apparatus.

title: Lithium-Ion Batteries for Portable Applications - Safety Requirements
summary: Specifies safety requirements for secondary lithium-ion cells and batteries used in portable electronic devices.
scope: Lithium-ion batteries used in mobile phones, laptops, and similar devices.

title: Household Washing Machines - Particular Safety Requirements
summary: Specifies particular safety requirements for household washing machines, building on the general household appliance safety standard.
scope: Domestic washing machines, top-load and front-load.

title: Electric Rice Cookers - Specification
summary: Specifies safety and performance requirements for domestic electric rice cookers.
scope: Household electric rice cookers.

title: Sampling Inspection Tables and Procedures
summary: Provides statistical sampling plans and procedures used for inspection of lots or batches during quality control.
scope: Quality inspection and acceptance sampling across manufacturing industries.

title: Quality Management Systems - Requirements (Indian Adoption of ISO 9001)
summary: Specifies requirements for a quality management system used by organizations to consistently provide products and services meeting customer and regulatory requirements.
scope: Organizations across all sectors seeking systems certification.

title: Domestic Pressure Cookers
summary: Specifies safety and performance requirements for aluminium and stainless steel domestic pressure cookers (1L to 22L capacity), covering pressure relief valves, gaskets, and locking mechanisms.
scope: Domestic pressure cookers intended for household cooking up to 22 litres capacity.

title: Gold and Gold Alloys, Jewellery/Artefacts — Fineness and Marking
summary: Prescribes fineness grades (e.g. 24K, 22K/916, 18K/750, 14K/585) and hallmarking requirements with HUID for gold jewellery and artefacts.
scope: Gold jewellery, gold coins, and precious artefacts sold in India.

title: Self-Ballasted LED Lamps for General Lighting Services
summary: Specifies safety and performance requirements for self-ballasted LED lamps for general lighting services in domestic and commercial applications.
scope: Mains-voltage tubular and omnidirectional LED bulbs up to 60W.
